{{recipe}}

'''Sugar pie''' is a traditional American pie known by several other names, including "Desperation Pie" (due to low ingredient count) and "Sugar Cream Pie". Under the last name, it is the official pie of the state of Indiana.

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie crust]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]] ([[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] can work if cornstarch is unavailable)
* 1 cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|Cinnamon]] or [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]] to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to about 375°F (190–200°C)
# In large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] milk without [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]]. 
# Dissolve sugar, cornstarch and butter into milk. Stir gently and allow to thicken for about 5 minutes.
# Pour mixture into pie crust and gently transfer into [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 22 minutes.
# Optionally engage [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] for a few minutes to caramelize the top of the pie.
